newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Best Buy, Tandy, Circuit, Rex cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Best Buy, Tandy, Circuit, Rex cut.

text.p: --Everen Securities analyst Beth Richard said she lowered earnings estimates for retailers Best Buy Co Inc, Tandy Corp, Circuit City Stores Inc and Rex Stores Corp due to weak consumer electronics sales.
--Shares in Best Buy were up 1/8 to 12-3/4; Tandy was up 1/4 to 39-1/8; Circuit City was off 1/8 to 34-5/8; and Rex was unchanged at 8-7/8.

--"In addition to the slow audio and video sales that we have been seeing throughout the whole year, we are now also seeing a significant slowdown in personal computer sales. Prices are continuing to plummet on many items while industry conditions remain promotional and competitive," Richard said regarding Best Buy.
